rules.statement: Don't report an accepted decision record as contradicted, or ask for its text to be edited or annotated, when the change carries out a future step that the record itself already prescribes.
rules.why: The record already decided the switch, so the change does what it says. Accepted records are never rewritten beyond their status line, and an amending record is only for a decision that has actually changed.
rules.check: Before raising a mismatch between config or code and an accepted ADR, read the whole ADR item for wording like 'the change that starts X sets it to Y', and check the decisions README's Statuses rule. Report only when the change departs from what the record prescribes. Even then, ask for a new amending record, not an edit to the accepted one.
